## Checklist
- [ ] `npm run lint` and `npm test` pass (and `npm run test:e2e` on Linux if the UI or IPC changed)
- [ ] Follows the ground rules in CONTRIBUTING.md (no network, no inline code, validated IPC, `textContent` for user text)
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under *Unreleased*
- [ ] New assets, if any, have a row in `assets/README.md` with source, author and licence
